text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is International Business Machines Corp.

Q1 1996 results exclude a non-recurring charge of $435 million to write off in-process research and development costs related to the acquisition of Tivoli Systems and Object Technology International in March 1996.
Including the acquisition-related charges, IBM Q1 1996 net earnings were $774 million or $1.41 per share.
The First Call consensus of Wall Street analyst estimates had projected Q1 1997 operating earnings of $2.28 per share.
Net earnings for both 1997 and 1996 are prior to the deduction of preferred stock dividends, which amounted to $5 million in both periods.
Q1 1997 earnings applicable to common shareholders, taking account of the dividends, were $1.19 billion vs $1.20 billion in Q1 1996 on an operating basis and $769 million on a net basis.
